name: squats knee position
description: A bodyweight squat focused on where your knees travel, helping you learn to track them over your toes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower into a squat.
Push your knees out so they follow the line of your toes.
Go down as deep as feels controlled.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.
